integrity: Proof is self-contained apart from the classical nontangential Poisson convergence theorem; numerical checker does not certify infinitely many functions, nor independent originality.
scientific_limitations: Strong-extremity classification only for the Poisson-variance Garsia norm on BMO, BMOA, VMO and VMOA modulo constants. Ordinary-extremity classification for general BMO/BMOA remains unaddressed. Convergence is nonquantitative without uniform Lebesgue point moduli. Priority risk from unindexed earlier literature remains.
title: No strongly extreme points in the Garsia-norm balls of BMO and BMOA
